title: EC 1.2.7 · Similarity-aware: all configurations with intervals
caption: All 49 configurations on the similarity-aware test set of EC 1.2.7, ranked by MCC, with 95% stratified bootstrap intervals. 36 of 49 intervals exclude zero. The median interval width is 0.59 (range 0.00–0.85), so neighbouring ranks are usually statistically indistinguishable. Colours mark the descriptor.
